correction.reason: The V2 depth model enforced a one-dollar notional floor but did not persist or enforce each CLOB market's published minimum_order_size. The active crypto books inspected at freeze published a five-share minimum. This is a venue-contract correction, not a performance-tuned threshold.
correction.evidence_policy: V1 and V2 remain immutable history and contribute zero V3 confirmation evidence.

mechanism.trigger: completed public sweep that walked beyond the displayed opposing touch
mechanism.decision: at the scheduled availability timestamp using only the latest causal book state
mechanism.followthrough: target executable bid improves by at least one token tick
mechanism.queue_confirmation: target top bid size is at least top ask size
mechanism.cost_hurdle: observed sweep displacement per share covers current spread plus exact entry and exit taker fees
mechanism.sizing: min($10 / arrival ask, 20% of displayed arrival ask size), provided the resulting shares meet the market-published minimum_order_size
mechanism.exit: executable full-size bid markout at 1s, 2s, 5s and 10s

selection_disclosure: V3 changes only execution feasibility after a venue-rule omission was found. It does not inherit V2 outcomes and it does not validate the post-selected final-ten-second boundary hypothesis.
zero_edge_disclosure: The valid expected outcome is that public completed flow contains no post-cost scalp edge.
